sections.advice: Ha Giang → Quan Ba Heaven Gate climbs about 1500 m in 33 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Quan Ba Heaven Gate → Dong Van drops about 1500 m over 56 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Dong Van → Ma Pi Leng Pass climbs about 1500 m in 7 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Ma Pi Leng Pass → Meo Vac drops about 1500 m over 12 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Meo Vac → Du Gia is 42 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Ha Giang Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 41 km. 1500 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Quan Ba Heaven Gate → Dong Van
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 69 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

scenicChapters.title: Ha Giang Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1500 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

ha-giang-loop-ha-giang-du-gia.story: 185 km one way from Hà Giang - plan on about 3 h 03 of riding. On the way it passes Quan Ba Heaven, Dong Van, Ma Pi Leng Pass and Meo Vac. The highest point is about 1,500 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

The stops in between: Selva di Cadore and Livinallongo del Col di Lana. The highest point is about 2,250 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
